description: Laravel is a PHP framework with routing, response helpers and collections. These first lessons work with small web replies. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create a practice Laravel project with Composer, then replace routes/web.php with one example. Start php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000. These read-only starter routes need no database.
versionNote: Examples use Laravel 11 or 12 with its supported PHP version.
whatYouWillLearn: Read a query value with Laravel
Send a client to another page with Laravel
learningObjectives: Limit a route input with Laravel
Set a cache rule with Laravel
